name: Cursed Jutsu
body:
Prerequisite(s): Jutsu pool class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain a hex as per the witch class feature, treating your ninja level as though it was your witch level to determine its DC and uses your Charisma in place of your Intelligence to determine its DC.

All effects of hexes end upon refreshing your jutsu pool. Using this hex costs 1 jutsu point, although hexes granted by this feat do not have any limitations of how often they can affect a creature.

Special: This feat can be selected multiple times, each time selecting a different hex.
